label: s2_sub_006_boy_01
text: All Pokémon Trainers dream of might! We’re\ndrawn to whatever’s mightiest!

label: s2_sub_006_boy_02
text: I’d love to see a Pokémon with the Mightiest\nMark someday. Can you show me one?!

label: s2_sub_006_boy_03
text: You don’t get to be the mightiest of anything by\nstaying in your comfort zone!

label: s2_sub_006_boy_04
text: That Pokémon doesn’t have the Mightiest Mark!

label: s2_sub_006_boy_06
text: Wow, that’s amazing! I’m jealous—but also\ninspired!

label: s2_sub_006_boy_07
text: Let me teach you a pose that’s all the rage in\nGalar as thanks!

label: s2_sub_006_system_01
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Charizard Pose emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from the\nstudent!

label: s2_sub_006_boy_npc
text: The Charizard Pose is the signature pose of one\nof Galar’s mightiest Champions!
